title: Healing from Trauma: Owning Your Self
coreMove: Recovery is not technique loyalty; it is the return of agency over alarm, attention, body sensation, memory, and relationship, one regulated choice at a time.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a teen may bolt before responsibility can become safe action
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show agency returning through care before verbal insight

exampleSpecs.stakes: symptom relief could be mistaken for complete repair
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep medication inside a wider recovery plan

exampleSpecs.stakes: isolation could turn one trigger into a week of threat
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show reliable relationship as treatment infrastructure

exampleSpecs.stakes: a useful exposure exercise could become another overwhelm drill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Set regulation before retelling or exposure

exampleSpecs.stakes: a student may confuse shutdown with discipline
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use bodily practice to restore felt agency

exampleSpecs.stakes: calm could be mistaken for memory integration
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Distinguish symptom dampening from owning traumatic memory
